summary: Brother of Temperance Smith (John's 7th-great-grand-uncle); former captain of the Upper Clove militia company.
bio:
The Upper Clove company was 'formerly commanded by Capt. Austin Smith'. Fence-viewer and assessor for Woodbury Clove in 1775.

Weygant (1897): in 1765 Austin Smith and John Earl were 'Overseers of Roads for Woodbury Clove', and in 1771 Austin was captain of the Woodbury Clove military company ([R4-S1]). WikiTree gives his wife as Mehitable Tuthill (unverified).
sources: [R4-S1] C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V (secondary) https://archive.org/details/familyrecor00weyg
